speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing on it. The bar is still, and nothing is hung. I am not giving you a sheet to change that. I looked, and I came back.

speaker: richard_field
text: Good. It stays so till morning. A cold bar is an honest bar. I am not heating it for a comedy that has no last act, and I am not asking thee to invent one in my doorway.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: You have seen a press. Now shut the leaf or keep it open, but choose. I am not standing in two rooms to watch a man hesitate. Non. I am sitting. The cups are still the cups.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am shutting it. Nothing under the question. The pages go home in the fold they came in.
